# 🎬 **Create. Record. Inspire.**

**wiktrEx YouTube Pack** is a premium toolkit curated by **wiktrEx**, specifically designed for content creators. This modpack doesn't just run the game; it transforms Minecraft into a professional production environment.

Whether you are filming high-quality cinematics, building complex structures, or streaming to your audience, this pack provides the perfect balance of visual fidelity and smooth performance. It removes the technical hurdles so you can focus on what matters most: **your content.**

---

## 🚀 **Key Features**

* **⚡ Optimized Performance:** Built on the Fabric ecosystem with *Sodium, Lithium,* and *FerriteCore* to ensure a rock-solid frame rate while recording.
* **🎨 Cinematic Visuals:** Includes top-tier shader packs (*Complementary, BSL, AstraLex*) and *Iris Shaders* for that professional "wow" factor.
* **🛠️ Creator Tools:** Includes *Litematica* for building, *Zoomify* for dynamic shots, and *Flashback* to capture your best gameplay moments.
* **⚙️ Seamless Control:** Fully configured with *YACL* and *Mod Menu*, allowing you to tweak every setting directly in-game.

---

## 📦 **Included Mods**

### **Performance & Stability**

> *Sodium, Sodium Extra, Lithium, FerriteCore, Reese's Sodium Options*

### **Visuals & Shaders**

> *Iris Shaders, Complementary (Unbound/Reimagined), BSL, AstraLex, LambDynamicLights, Visual Vibrance, Continuity*

### **Tools & Utilities**

> *Litematica, Flashback, Zoomify, Geckolib, Essential Mod, Mellow*

### **Core Libraries**

> *Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, Mod Menu, YetAnotherConfigLib, Forge Config API Port, Text Placeholder API*

---

*Transform your Minecraft experience today. Create, record, and inspire!*
